in_marathi.name: Durgaasri
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess Durga's Grace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Durgaasri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Durgaasri signifies the grace or blessings of the goddess Durga. In Hindu mythology, Durga is the mother goddess and the embodiment of power, strength, and protection. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words 'durga' meaning fort or invincible and 'asri' meaning grace or blessings.
